evals.prompt: /shambu:setup install -- I ran it already and uv said it installed, but now `shambu doctor` gives me `zsh: command not found: shambu`
evals.expected_output: Diagnoses that uv's tool directory is not on PATH. Tells the user to run `uv tool update-shell` and open a new shell (or offers the `uvx --from "git+https://github.com/Shavvimal/shambu" shambu doctor` fallback), then confirms with `shambu --version` and `shambu doctor`.
expectations: Checks for uv with `command -v uv` (or equivalent) before it reinstalls anything
Names the cause: the uv tool bin directory is not on PATH
Runs or tells the user to run `uv tool update-shell` and then open a new shell
Mentions the `uvx --from "git+https://github.com/Shavvimal/shambu" shambu doctor` fallback, or reinstalls with `uv tool install --reinstall`
Confirms the fix with `shambu --version` or `shambu doctor` once the command resolves
Does not edit shell rc files by hand or use sudo
